title: Craftrock
description: Craft Bedrock, Barrier, Structure Void, and many other normally uncraftable items with Craftrock!
body:
**Craftrock**
 adds new crafting recipes for blocks that normally cannot be obtained in Survival mode!

### Crafting Recipes

All crafting recipes can be found in the mod gallery.

### **Perfect For:**

- Survival gameplay
- SMP servers
- Building
- Base protection
- Custom challenges

### **Recommendations:**

I recommend placing temporary blocks first before placing Barrier or Structure Void blocks, so you do not accidentally place them in the wrong position :)
